gate: SOURCE TYPES: IMPLEMENTED — READY FOR INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION
scope_note: No live source was added, configured or contacted. Every strategy is exercised against an injected in-process transport only, so the evidence is reproducible offline.

source_types.wahoo: legacy alias, registered against the paginated HTML adapter

shared_infrastructure.transport_guarantee: Every HTTP method of every strategy, including a form submission, an authenticated JSON GET, a JSON POST body, a feed read and inherited HTML detail/attachment reads, is issued through the one injected transport, so robots, user-agent, pacing, timeout, retry/backoff and Retry-After handling cannot be bypassed.

shared_semantics.normalization: One shared text, whitespace, reference, absolute-URL, timestamp and identity path, so two strategies cannot disagree about what a title or an external_id is.
shared_semantics.provenance: Every listing and detail record carries the source, the URL it came from, the correlation id and the crawl timestamp.
shared_semantics.bundle_discipline: An archive is recorded as one attachment; inner files are never enumerated (prompt 07 §3).
shared_semantics.dedupe: Per-crawl external_id deduplication is unconditional inside each adapter. stop_when_no_new_items only controls termination. Persisted dedupe and update classification stay in DedupService.

strategy_notes.paginated_html_list: Cross-page external_id dedupe, page cap, visited-URL set, optional no-new-items stopping, selector lists, reusable _crawl, _start_url. WahoPaginatedAdapter remains the compatibility alias.
strategy_notes.filtered_html: Configured facet combination applied through query parameters, plus the same page cap, visited-URL set and cross-page dedupe as the paginated strategy.
strategy_notes.search_form: Form submission goes through an injected FormDriver. requires_browser fails explicitly with SOURCE_NOT_RUNNABLE unless a browser-capable driver is supplied; a plain Requester never satisfies it. No browser dependency is introduced.
strategy_notes.rss_atom: RSS, RDF and Atom, including content:encoded, dc:creator, dc:date, category and enclosure. A feed entry with no link falls back to the feed URL for identity.
strategy_notes.json_api: items_path and per-field paths with candidate lists, nested detail_paths, page/offset/cursor pagination bounded by page cap, visited URLs and declared total, short-page stop, GET or POST with an optional body, auth resolved through AuthResolver and cleared after the crawl, and detail_response_kind json or html.

configuration_only_acceptance_test.proves: Two configured source rows of one source type are built as the same adapter class with independent selectors, URLs, detail templates and query parameters, and dedup remains source-scoped.

tests.ruff: passed on sources, registry, interface and all four new test files

mypy.classification: Pre-existing _parse_deadline inference errors. Verified outside every added or changed diff hunk, so they were not introduced by this work and were not modified.

full_suite.classification: Separate out-of-scope Prompt 12.1 regression: the test source carries replacement characters, so the French accented pattern cannot match. Not modified.

limitations: A source needing a browser still cannot run: it fails explicitly with SOURCE_NOT_RUNNABLE until a browser-capable FormDriver is supplied, because no browser dependency may be added.
Pagination for JSON APIs without a declared page size cannot know its own end and therefore relies on the page cap or an empty page; declaring page_size, limit or per_page gives a short-page stop.
A deadline without an explicit offset, Z or UTC marker is rejected rather than silently assumed to be UTC.

Auth is supported through AuthResolver references only. No new credential store or secret lifecycle was added; plaintext secrets never enter configuration, logs, listing metadata or retained adapter state.
